title: A foundation model to predict and capture human cognition (Centaur)
description: Nature article introducing Centaur: Llama 3.1 70B fine-tuned with QLoRA (rank-8 adapters on all non-embedding layers, about 0.15% added parameters, one epoch, loss on human-response tokens only) on Psych-101, natural-language transcripts of trial-by-trial data from 160 experiments (60,092 participants, 10,681,650 choices). Reported evaluation: negative log-likelihood on held-out participants (90% of participants per experiment for training, 10% for testing) against the un-fine-tuned base model and 14 domain-specific cognitive models; open-loop simulations (horizon task, two-step task); a test on economic-game responses of humans and of artificial agents; out-of-distribution tests with a modified cover story (two-step task), a modified problem structure (Maggie's farm, a three-armed bandit) and a new domain (logical reasoning), plus six further paradigms outside the training data; alignment of internal representations with fMRI data (two-step task; sentence reading); and a model-guided discovery case study. The arXiv preprint is titled 'Centaur: a foundation model of human cognition'.

rightsNotes: Published article: 'This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License' (PMC copy, read 2026-10-31). The arXiv preprint is also CC BY 4.0 (abstract-page licence link).

Host terms: nature.com's Website Terms prohibit access 'by any means other than through a normal web browser in the generally-accepted manner', and the PMC copyright page says 'Do not use any other automated processes for downloading articles' beyond its OAI-PMH, FTP and Cloud services. The published version is cited, not imported; the CC BY arXiv v3 may be imported from arxiv.org.

Model weights (Hugging Face marcelbinz/Llama-3.1-Centaur-70B-adapter and the merged marcelbinz/Llama-3.1-Centaur-70B): licence tag 'llama3.1' (Llama 3.1 Community License Agreement). The adapter card says running it needs about 80 GB of GPU memory. Corniversity does not download or run the models.

Training data Psych-101: Apache-2.0 on Hugging Face (record psych-101). Test set marcelbinz/Psych-101-test: 'cc-by-nd-4.0', gated, 'Private test set for Psych-101. Do not redistribute outside of this repository.' Not accessed.

Corniversity decision (2026-10-31): the CC BY arXiv preprint is the working copy, because it may be imported for private study; the Nature article is the version of record, read in the browser and cited for the published results. The two texts were not compared line by line.
